subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and if so what storage, validation, authorization, overwrite, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The missing feature would add browser file ingestion, workspace writes, and served avatar content, so automation should not choose the security model or source-of-truth policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload flow that validates images, writes under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current avatar serving protections.

options.title: Keep existing manual/local paths
options.body: Continue supporting CLI or manual identity configuration plus the browser-local Quick Settings override, avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave this out of core until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload flow that validates images, writes under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current avatar serving protections.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from the original avatar-support merge history and the product/security nature of the new upload surface.
